newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH MINISTER DLOUHY PLANS CHINA, SINGAPORE TRIP.
newsitem.headline: CZECH MINISTER DLOUHY PLANS CHINA, SINGAPORE TRIP.

text.p: Czech Industy and Trade Minister Vladimir Dlouhy will visit China later this week to meet Prime Minister Li Peng and other officials, his ministry said on Monday.

Spokesman Miroslav Konvalina said Dlouhy would also discuss economic issues with China's foreign trade minister Wu Yi on the December 4 through 7 trip, including Czech technology exports and joint investment plans.
Czech industrial and energy companies, including engineering concern Skoda a.s. have started investments in China.
Konvalina added that Dlouhy is due to lead the Czech delegation to the World Trade Organisation summit in Singapore next week after concluding the Chinese visit.
